options.text: Report the word trend as the Day $3$ water level.
The water level peaks on Day $3$ at $40\,\mathrm{L}$, and the steepest rise is from Day $2$ to Day $3$.
The water level on Day $6$ is $50\,\mathrm{L}$.
The peak value equals the day number printed on the axis.

stem:
The graph shows the water level in litres in Wahid's tank over five days.

Which claim is supported by the graph?

teacher.key_rationale: Plotted values peak on Day 3 at 40 L; the largest rise over one day interval is from Day 2 (25 L) to Day 3 (40 L).
teacher.figure_note: Line graph of tank water level over five days.
